title: Hardwired… to Self-Destruct
headline: Kirk Hammett lost almost 250 riffs at Copenhagen Airport
caption:
The album ran to twelve tracks over two discs, nearly eighty minutes of new music.

Bassist Robert Trujillo got one writing credit on it, the intro to "ManUNkind". He later said he wrote it as a tribute to Cliff Burton, the band's former bassist. And the title came from a line someone said to Hetfield that stuck with him, "Hardwired... Hardwired to Self-Destruct", which he took to mean the path you're trying not to go down.

🎧 Key track: "Hardwired" by Metallica (@metallica)

Source: statements by Kirk Hammett, Robert Trujillo and James Hetfield (via Wikipedia)
